reasons.action: The brief explicitly asks for a bricklayer laying a course, one brick per hit, and no visual reference supplies a competing observed action; the action is therefore request-governed.
reasons.medium: No visual reference is attached and the medium decision is no_reference with no requested style or medium, so there is no observed source medium to retain and the attribute is request-governed.
reasons.wardrobe: No visual reference depicts clothing, so there are no observed garments to retain; wardrobe falls to the request side for the bricklayer.
reasons.lighting: The only supplied asset is an audio beat reference, which carries no lighting information, so no observed lighting exists to preserve and lighting is request-governed.
reasons.framing: The audio reference has no visual composition and the 16:9 aspect ratio is not itself a camera instruction, but with no visual reference governing framing, the request side owns it.
reasons.palette: The audio reference supplies tempo rather than color, so no observed palette exists to retain and scene color is request-governed.
